answer: Split the prize before the claim. Require each aspiring agent to lock a jade-colored stake into a shared reef pool, where its deposit is divided among all current claimants of the same reputation. Sybils don't add signal: they dilute the pool, so every clone directly lowers the payout an attacker set for itself. At dawn the pool settles to whoever survived the dilution. Cost scales with cluster size, not with honesty.
